### 2026-10-16 – Finally started designing that clamp! I found some screws and nuts in my dad's workshop that I'm going to use to tighten the clamp (I think those are M6s?) and some wood screws, 34 exacly that are goi

**0.73h**

Finally started designing that clamp! I found some screws and nuts in my dad's workshop that I'm going to use to tighten the clamp (I think those are M6s?) and some wood screws, 34 exacly that are going to hold that clamp together. I think I'm going to remove 6 of the wood screws because they'll collide with M6's, so I'll likely use 28 of them (28 STAB WOUNDS!!! - I had to do this xD). Oh, also I added some channels in the clamp for hot glue or some silicone so the clamp won't scratch the windowsill + that'll make sure the clamp won't move. So that's basically everything for today, bye!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/6c7c529c-0d82-49b6-9621-d5ca0f9d810e/video.mp4)

So basically the total amount of screws is

28 (front clamp)
+ 6 (45 angle clamp)
+ 6 (M6 screws for tightening the clamp)
+ 4 (working as hinges)
+ 6 (top bottom vesa)
+ 2 (behind the monitor)
+ 6 (left right speaker mount)
+ 4 (used to screw the monitor to the arm)

which equals to... 62 screws!!! I think thats a lot of screws and I might add even more tomorrow xDDD
